formula: (daily high > county- and calendar-date-specific historical 90th percentile) AND (daily high >= 80 degF), for at least 5 consecutive days
HWF: annual number of days participating in events
HWD: longest event duration (NOT the median event duration)
is_a_heatwave: part - relative anomaly AND an absolute daily-high gate
naming_note: TX in the identifier is the ETCCDI symbol for the daily maximum temperature, not the state abbreviation. This construct is not TX90p: TX90p is a warm-day FREQUENCY index and does not encode event duration.
gate_note: 80 degF and 90 degF are absolute daily-high gates chosen for this sensitivity test. They are NOT National Weather Service advisory thresholds.
